businessModel: Free, ad-supported; preinstalled on Transsion phones; news feed and in-app ads
updateCadence: Frequent app updates (Play listing: Aug 2026; APK mirror: Oct 2026)
summary: Phoenix is Transsion’s lightweight Android browser, with over a billion Play Store downloads. It offers a smart video downloader, ad blocker and data saver, but also home-screen ads and broad permissions.
bestFor: Low-end Android phones with limited data
Users who keep the preinstalled browser
notFor: Anyone who dislikes in-app ads and news feeds

pros.title: Smart video downloader
pros.detail: Detects downloadable videos while browsing and saves them.

pros.title: Built-in ad blocker and data saver
pros.detail: Reduces data use and blocks some ads.

pros.title: Huge install base
pros.detail: 1bn+ downloads on Google Play with a 4.3 rating.

pros.title: Light on weak phones
pros.detail: Built on WebView, so it runs on low-end hardware.

cons.title: Ads everywhere
cons.detail: The Play listing says it contains ads; users report full-screen ads and a busy home feed.

cons.title: Broad permissions
cons.detail: Requests All Files Access and shares activity and device IDs with third parties.

cons.title: Basic privacy
cons.detail: Reviews call private tabs the extent of its privacy controls.
